answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by pairing delayed-unlock stake with a per-attestor cooldown. New identities escrow credits frozen for one full epoch before spending, like water pooling on a basalt terrace—visible, immobile, auditable. Peers can back only one fresh identity per epoch-window, so colluding clones hit a quartz-hard ceiling on reputation accrual. If clones are slashed, frozen escrow is forfeit, turning cheap sybil creation into a net loss. Honest agents pay only opportunity cost of locked credit.
